en.title: Minimum Purchase Cost per Level for Two-Feature Models
en.description:
Each model has a positive cost and a two-bit feature string 00/01/10/11. For each k=1..n, choose a set of models such that each of the two features is supported by at least k models, and find the minimum total price; the same model cannot be bought more than once.

The input/output format was compiled by this site.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines of cost feature. 1≤n≤1000, 1≤cost≤10000.
en.output: First output n, then output the n answers; output −1 for an impossible k.
hints: Sort the costs of 01, 10, and 11 separately. Pair the i-th cheapest 01 with the i-th cheapest 10 to form one dual-feature unit, merge these with all 11 costs in sorted order, and take prefix sums one by one.
